questions.prompt: To turn the error code of the last failed call into text, use `strerror({{0}})`.
questions.explain: `errno` (from `<errno.h>`) holds the code of the last failure; `strerror` (from `<string.h>`) returns a message such as "No such file or directory".
Errors go to stderr (descriptor 2) so they stay visible when stdout is redirected to a file or a pipe.
